section: Integrated Guided Missile Development Programme - Prithvi, Agni, Akash, Trishul, Nag
subsections: Missile Technology Control Regime - India's membership
Persons in the missile programme → role and title

accepted.s: India joined the Missile Technology Control Regime (MTCR) in which year and as which numbered member?
accepted.x: India joined the MTCR in June 2016 as its 35th member.
accepted.tq: Separate the closely spaced year and membership-number options.
accepted.sec: Missile Technology Control Regime - India's membership

accepted.s: The Missile Technology Control Regime is primarily an informal export-control regime concerning missiles and unmanned aerial vehicles capable of carrying:
accepted.x: The MTCR concerns missiles and UAVs able to carry a 500 kg payload over a range of 300 km.
accepted.tq: Split the options by checking both the payload and range figures.
accepted.sec: Missile Technology Control Regime - India's membership

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding India's membership of the MTCR:
1. It facilitated the export of BrahMos missiles.
2. It made high-technology imports easier for India.
3. China is a member of the MTCR.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: India's MTCR membership facilitated BrahMos exports and high-technology imports. China is not a member, so statement 3 is false.
accepted.tq: Find the swapped-membership statement before selecting the coded combination.
accepted.sec: Missile Technology Control Regime - India's membership

accepted.s: Dr A.P.J. Abdul Kalam served as the project director of which programme associated with Rohini?
accepted.x: Dr A.P.J. Abdul Kalam was the project director of the SLV-III programme associated with Rohini.
accepted.tq: Use the person-to-project association rather than the person’s popular title.
accepted.sec: Persons in the missile programme → role and title

accepted.s: At Pokhran in 1998, Dr A.P.J. Abdul Kalam served as the:
accepted.x: Dr A.P.J. Abdul Kalam was the Chief Scientific Adviser at Pokhran in 1998.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between a specific advisory title and neighbouring defence posts.
accepted.sec: Persons in the missile programme → role and title

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements about Dr A.P.J. Abdul Kalam is correct?
o: He was the first Indian Head of State to pilot a spacecraft.
He was the first Indian Head of State to command a submarine.
He was the first Indian Head of State to fly a fighter aircraft.
He was the first Indian Head of State to serve as DRDO Chairman.
accepted.x: Dr A.P.J. Abdul Kalam was the first Indian Head of State to fly a fighter aircraft.
accepted.tq: Reject exaggerated or substituted claims by identifying the precise achievement.
accepted.sec: Persons in the missile programme → role and title

accepted.s: Dr Tessy Thomas is associated with which combination of descriptions?
o: Missile Woman of India, key role in Agni-V and “Agniputri”
Missile Man of India, leadership of IGMDP and SLV-III
Former DRDO chief, leadership of Prithvi and BMD
Chairman of DRDO, leadership of Akash Tarang and MPATGM
accepted.x: Dr Tessy Thomas is known as the “Missile Woman of India”, played a key role in Agni-V and is called “Agniputri”.
accepted.tq: Use the unique title-and-project combination to identify the correct person.
accepted.sec: Persons in the missile programme → role and title

accepted.s:
With reference to Dr V.K. Saraswat, consider the following statements:
1. He served as a former DRDO chief.
2. He led work relating to Prithvi.
3. He led the ballistic missile defence programme.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. Dr V.K. Saraswat was a former DRDO chief and led the Prithvi and ballistic missile defence programmes.
accepted.tq: Check whether all three role descriptions belong to the same specialist.
accepted.sec: Persons in the missile programme → role and title

accepted.s: Who is the current Chairman of the Defence Research and Development Organisation?
accepted.x: Samir V. Kamat is the current Chairman of the DRDO.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the current office-holder from former programme leaders.
accepted.sec: Persons in the missile programme → role and title

accepted.s: The Trishul missile was designed as a:
accepted.x: Trishul was a short-range, quick-reaction surface-to-air missile.
accepted.tq: Identify the missile by combining its range class, reaction role and launch category.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the Trishul missile?
o: It had a speed above Mach 2 and used solid propellant with thrust-vector control.
It had subsonic speed and used a turbojet engine.
It had a speed below Mach 1 and used liquid propellant.
It had a speed above Mach 5 and used nuclear propulsion.
accepted.x: Trishul had a speed above Mach 2 and used solid propellant with thrust-vector control.
accepted.tq: Compare the speed class and propulsion features, rejecting incompatible combinations.

accepted.s: The approximate range of the Trishul missile was reported as:
accepted.x: The approximate range of Trishul was about 9 km; another stated figure placed it at 12 km, but the cited approximate value is 9 km.
accepted.tq: Select the short-range figure associated with Trishul rather than figures belonging to longer-range systems.

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements regarding the Trishul programme is correct?
o: It was converted into the Agni-V programme in 2016.
It was never inducted and was shut on 27 February 2008.
It was inducted into all three Services in 2008.
It was inducted by the Navy but cancelled by the Air Force in 1998.
accepted.x: Trishul was never inducted, and its programme was shut on 27 February 2008 because of delays and cost overruns.
accepted.tq: Use the first-and-last programme facts to reject claims of induction or conversion.

accepted.s: The principal replacement for Trishul in the Indian Air Force was:
accepted.x: The Israeli Spyder replaced Trishul in the Indian Air Force.
accepted.tq: Match the Service with its specific replacement rather than the indigenous successor.

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer using the code given below:

List-I (Service)
A. Indian Air Force
B. Indian Navy
C. Indian Army

List-II (Replacement)
1. Akash
2. Barak-1
3. Israeli Spyder

A B C
(a) 3 2 1
(b) 2 3 1
(c) 1 2 3
(d) 3 1 2
accepted.x: The Indian Air Force was associated with Israeli Spyder, the Navy with Barak-1 and the Army with Akash. Thus the combination is A-3, B-2 and C-1.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure Service-replacement pair and complete the code.

accepted.s: The later indigenous short-range successor to Trishul is known as:
accepted.x: QRSAM, or Quick Reaction Surface-to-Air Missile, is the later indigenous short-range successor to Trishul.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the indigenous successor from the Service-specific replacement systems.

accepted.s: Which missile was the first missile developed under the Integrated Guided Missile Development Programme?
accepted.x: Prithvi was the first missile of the IGMDP.
accepted.tq: Apply the programme’s first-versus-last distinction carefully.

accepted.s: Which one of the following is the IGMDP missile that was never inducted?
accepted.x: Trishul is the IGMDP missile that was never inducted; its programme was shut in 2008.
accepted.tq: Use the distinctive exception within the IGMDP missile group.

accepted.s: The Integrated Guided Missile Development Programme is regarded as significant because it:
o: Ended all missile development in India after the completion of Prithvi.
Turned India from a missile importer into a missile-exporting power and formed a base for later Agni-V MIRV, BMD and BrahMos-era programmes.
Restricted India to importing surface-to-air missiles from foreign suppliers.
Was created exclusively for developing civilian launch vehicles.
accepted.x: The IGMDP transformed India from a missile importer into a missile-exporting power and provided the foundation for Agni-V MIRV, ballistic missile defence and BrahMos-era programmes.
accepted.tq: Select the option that captures both the strategic transformation and the later technological base.

accepted.s: The Ministry of Defence approval concerning technology transfer of conventional missiles includes which of the following arrangements?
o: Transfer of technology of conventional missiles, including Nag, to private industry, while keeping Agni in state production
Transfer of all Agni variants to private industry and cancellation of Nag
Transfer of only civilian launch vehicles to private industry
Keeping Nag in state production while transferring Agni exclusively to foreign companies
accepted.x: The approval provides for transfer of technology of conventional missiles, including Nag, to private industry, while Agni remains in state production.
accepted.tq: Watch for the reversed treatment of Nag and Agni in the policy arrangement.

accepted.s: The Agni-4 user trial reported from Chandipur took place on:
accepted.x: The Agni-4 user trial at Chandipur was reported on 7 August 2026.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between adjacent dates associated with testing and user trials.

accepted.s: Which of the following developments was approved in July 2026?
accepted.x: Akash Tarang and MPATGM were approved in July 2026.
accepted.tq: Match the month-specific approval with the correct pair of systems.
